diagnostics.message: :resource.helm_release.karpenter: explicit depends_on of :module.eks is redundant — already implied by attribute references

helm_release.karpenter already depends on module.eks implicitly: its `values` template interpolates module.eks.cluster_name and module.eks.cluster_endpoint (and its Karpenter settings come from module.karpenter). The explicit `depends_on = [module.eks]` therefore duplicates an ordering edge Terraform already inferred from those attribute references and can be dropped.

helm_release.karpenter installs the Karpenter controller, which obtains AWS credentials through the EKS Pod Identity association created by module.karpenter (`create_pod_identity_association = true`). That requires the eks-pod-identity-agent add-on (and the self-managed node group hosting its DaemonSet) to already be present/ready. The release currently only orders against module.eks and module.karpenter; it should also wait for aws_eks_addon.eks_pod_identity_agent (e.g. via depends_on) so the controller does not start without a working Pod Identity agent.
